create_openai_api_backend: create an OpenAIAPI backend instance with a custom model name and API key
generate_text_openai_api: generate text from a prompt using the OpenAIAPI generate_text method with temperature and max_tokens
generate_texts_openai_api: generate multiple text samples from a single prompt using the OpenAIAPI generate_texts method
generate_object_openai_api: generate a structured Pydantic object from a prompt using the OpenAIAPI generate_object method
chat_openai_api: chat with the OpenAIAPI backend by passing a sequence of messages and receiving a string response
